title: A dialogue box
description:
Show dialogue one letter at a time, wrapped to fit a box.

```
box 30 characters wide, 3 lines
"The old wizard looks up from his book and smiles at you."
t=0.5 s: "The old wizard lo"
press Enter: show the rest at once
press Enter again: next page
```
hints: Add words to the current line while `line.size() + 1 + word.size() <= width` (lesson 2.03).
A UTF-8 continuation byte matches `(c & 0xC0) == 0x80`; when cutting, move back while you are on one.
requirements: Wrap words into lines of at most the box width; a page is the box's number of lines.
Letters appear at 30 per second; Enter first finishes the page, then moves to the next.
Count letters with UTF-8 in mind: never cut a multi-byte character.
stretch: Allow `{red}` tags that change the colour and do not take space.
